exposure: increased/excessive fetal movements in the third trimester
outcome: Apgar score (appearance, pulse, grimace, activity, respiration)
conditions of umbilical cord around the neck and cord length
incidence of small for gestational age (SGA)
cohort: The study included pregnant women (n = 219) who reported increased/excessive fetal movements in the third trimester and a control group (n = 278) of healthy women who had undergone regular childbirth.
finding: Increased/excessive fetal movements were associated with a higher incidence of large for gestational age (LGA), particularly in those with gestational age over 37 weeks.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth rate was associated with increased/excessive fetal movements.
followup_time: Up to the immediate postpartum/neonatal period
gest_age: Pregnant women in their third trimester
